title: Bandwidth Monitor
description: Interfaces, top talkers, geography, latency, DNS, Wi-Fi, conntrack and speed tests exported by bandwidth-monitor's /metrics endpoint.

list.name: wan
list.label: WAN
list.description: Latency probe path. Per-WAN probes exist only on multi-WAN hosts; All also includes default-route probes, which have no wan label.

panels.title: WAN download
panels.description: Current receive throughput summed over all WAN interfaces.

panels.title: WAN upload
panels.description: Current transmit throughput summed over all WAN interfaces.

panels.title: WAN traffic (range)
panels.description: Total WAN bytes (rx + tx) in the selected time range.

panels.title: WAN throughput
panels.description: Download above the axis, upload below. Computed from interface byte counters.

panels.title: Throughput per interface
panels.description: Receive above the axis, transmit below.

panels.title: Errors & drops
panels.description: Only interfaces with non-zero error/drop rates are shown.

panels.title: Top clients — current rate
panels.description: Local clients with the highest current throughput (rx + tx).

panels.title: Top talkers — current rate
panels.description: All hosts (local and remote) with the highest current throughput.

panels.title: Per-WAN ICMP comparison
panels.description: Current ICMP latency and loss per target and probe path. On multi-WAN hosts each WAN is probed separately (sockets bound to the interface); "default route" is the unbound probe.

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: Queries in the DNS provider's statistics window.

targets.expr: sum by (radio, quality) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(bandwidth_monitor_wifi_clients_by_signal{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}, "radio", "2.4 GHz", "radio", "ng"), "radio", "5 GHz", "radio", "na"), "radio", "6 GHz", "radio", "6e"))

max by (hostname, ssid, ap, radio) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(bandwidth_monitor_wifi_top_client_signal_dbm{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}, "radio", "2.4 GHz", "radio", "ng"), "radio", "5 GHz", "radio", "na"), "radio", "6 GHz", "radio", "6e"))

sum by (hostname, ssid, ap, radio) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(bandwidth_monitor_wifi_top_client_rate_bytes_per_second{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}, "radio", "2.4 GHz", "radio", "ng"), "radio", "5 GHz", "radio", "na"), "radio", "6 GHz", "radio", "6e")) * 8

panels.title: Speed test results
panels.description: Results of speed tests triggered from the web UI (latest per interface).

panels.title: Capture ring packets
panels.description: Packets per second the kernel delivered to the top-talkers capture ring, per capture device.

panels.title: Capture ring drops
panels.description: Packets per second the kernel dropped because the capture ring was full. Sustained drops mean top-talker stats undercount traffic.

panels.title: Capture drop ratio
panels.description: Share of packets dropped by the capture ring over the selected time range.
